title: The Royal Blue
subtitle: A Ceylon blue of the saturation the salerooms still call ideal.

stone.origin: A pear-shaped Ceylon sapphire of the saturation that auction houses still call ideal — held by half-moon diamonds, carried on a Chalice of Blaze® shank in dialogue with pavé.

description: A pear-shaped Ceylon sapphire of the deep, even saturation that auction houses still hold up as the standard, set as the single point of colour in the ring. Half-moon diamonds hold it from either side, their clean edges framing the stone without crowding it, and the sapphire is carried on a Chalice of Blaze® shank set in quiet dialogue with pavé. Everything is arranged so the blue reads first and longest — colour given the centre, and light gathered around it in platinum.
